title: While and As Long As
goal: Use mientras + indicative for two things happening at once and mientras + subjunctive for "as long as".

items: I can use mientras with the subjunctive to say "as long as", for a duration or a condition.
I can use mientras with the indicative for two things happening at the same time.
I can use the new words for duration and conditions.
